body:
Yesterday, I made a crude extract of lemon balm by taking approximately 6 grams of fresh leaves, grinding them and soaking them in denatured alcohol for about 3 hours. I filtered out the plant matter, and evaporated the alcohol leaving somewhere around 500mg of dark, crystalline material. I took this and mixed it with about 15 ml of glycerine, and after heating for a while, got most of the material to dissolve.
I mixed the end result with some 24mg e-juice (about 10% of the total volume), mixed some more, and inhaled the vapour from about 5 drops of the liquid. The flavour was great, no nicotine burn, and a slight lemon balm taste. After a few hits, I could feel myself becoming slightly dizzy, and once I finished it, I felt like I was about to fall over. At this point however, I was in a land of bliss. I felt as if the world were perfectly at peace, very similarly to MDMA. I also had a bit of a headache and felt slightly nauseous, but it didn't matter. I kept talking to myself, amazed by how high I had gotten from such a simple plant.
After about 20 minutes the dizziness started to wear off, and I tried some more. However, it didn't seem to have much effect at all. Overall, I am very pleased with this plant, and will probably keep experimenting with it in the future.
